triage.note: D10 defect 2, from the browser-agent repo's 2026-08-24 demo postmortem shape S2. `#banner` is the only element on the page that reports `doc_status`, and it shipped as a bare `<div id="banner" class="s-idle">` — accessibility role `generic`, which that repo's observer drops via SKIP_ROLES, so the one answer the inspector exists to give was not the accessible name of anything. Watched red against the unmodified file: `#banner: role is None, want 'status' — a bare div is `generic` and carries no name for doc_status` plus `#banner: no accessible name (aria-label/aria-labelledby) — role=status alone leaves the region anonymous`. Green once the div carries role=status + aria-label="doc_status". role=status is CORRECT here rather than agent-special-casing: the element is a polite live region that JS rewrites after every extraction (`render()` and `busy()` both assign into it), which is exactly what role=status describes.

provenance: D10, created 2026-08-26 before the ARIA fix, per hard rule 2. Narrative: browser-agent repo docs/evals/2026-08-24-demo-sec10k-inspector-postmortem.md section 3, remediation item 2.
